# forgejo_oauth2_application (Resource)

An OAuth2 application owned by the authenticated user. Authenticate as the existing application's owner when importing by numeric application ID. The client secret is returned on creation and regenerated on every update. It is stored in state; import cannot recover it. Coordinate updates with consumers. This is not an external login/authentication source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "forgejo" {
  host = "https://forgejo.example.com"
  # FORGEJO_API_TOKEN must belong to the application owner.
}

resource "forgejo_oauth2_application" "woodpecker" {
  name                = "Woodpecker CI"
  redirect_uris       = ["https://woodpecker.example.com/authorize"]
  confidential_client = true
  # Every API update regenerates client_secret. Deliver the new value to the
  # consumer in the same rollout. Encrypt state and never print the secret.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Application name.
- `redirect_uris` (Set of String) Allowed redirect URIs.

### Optional

- `confidential_client` (Boolean) Whether this is a confidential client. Public clients require PKCE.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String)
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret, returned on creation and regenerated by Forgejo on every update. Null after import; existing secrets are not recoverable.
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Authenticate as the application owner; import cannot recover its secret.
terraform import forgejo_oauth2_application.woodpecker 123
```
